recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if FHIR-I later revives a broader CapabilityStatement2 feature model; any future adjustment to the expectation extension itself belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-31562 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I R5 issue asking for a structural way in CapabilityStatement to state which `_include:iterate` parameters SHALL be supported, with the accepted resolution pointing to CapabilityStatement2 feature work and expectation-extension scope.
initial_application: The issue was applied through the CapabilityStatement searchInclude guidance family rather than a separate CapabilityStatement2 feature element. FHIR-36051 commit 3b6e443e496f907801189a895636c924267804eb added root-resource recursive include guidance, and commit a2e0206d1d15324a318ed83dd5d55c65be16e584 explicitly named FHIR-31562 while changing the wording and example to `_include:iterate`.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current `searchInclude` comment says iterative include support is communicated by listing the iterative include values supported by the server under the root resource type. The `capabilitystatement-expectation` extension now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack and includes contexts for `CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.searchInclude` and `searchRevInclude`. A Zulip application thread records Eric Haas explaining that FHIR-36051 was the separate tracker for the FHIR-31562 point and that the modifier terminology was fixed to `:iterate`.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit was needed because current source already conveys the declaration rule and the relevant expectation extension is available on the include/revinclude value elements outside this core checkout.

related_jiras.note: Its Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution and source application established that recursive/iterative include values are declared on the root resource type's searchInclude list.
